PROXY_PORT_CHANGE_TOOLTIP: Change the selected web proxy capture's port. Stop capture first.
PROXY_PORT_INVALID: Enter a whole-number port from 1 through 65535.
PROXY_PORT_RANGE_INVALID: The automatic proxy range must start at 1 or higher and end at or after its starting port.
PROXY_PORT_EXHAUSTED: All proxy ports from {0} through {1} are assigned. Expand the automatic range in Preferences, close an unused capture, or choose a different port explicitly.
PROXY_PORT_IN_USE: Port {0} is already assigned to {1}. Select another port.
PROXY_PORT_USE_CHANGE: Stop capture and use Change Proxy Port to change an assigned port.
PROXY_PORT_STOP_FIRST: Stop capture and wait for the current operation before changing its proxy port.
PROXY_PORT_PENDING: Port {0} is pending. Apply it to disable/re-enable proxying, or discard the pending change.
PROXY_PORT_NO_PENDING: Select an available replacement port before applying the change.
PROXY_PORT_PENDING_START: Apply or discard the pending port change before starting capture.
PROXY_PORT_DISABLING: Disabling the old proxy. Waiting for the console to restart and confirm proxying is disabled...
PROXY_PORT_ENABLING: Enabling the proxy. The console may be restarting; the effective endpoint is not yet confirmed.
PROXY_PORT_APPLIED: The new proxy endpoint was confirmed.
PROXY_PORT_APPLY_FAILED: Port {0} remains assigned. Applying the change did not complete: {1}. Check proxy status before retrying or disabling.
PROXY_PORT_BUSY_CLOSE: A proxy operation is still running. Cancel applying and wait for it to finish before closing this capture.
PROXY_PORT_INSTRUCTIONS_XBOX: Apply now starts capture and disables/re-enables the console proxy. The Xbox may restart twice. Later saves a pending change and leaves the console and current port unchanged. Captured history is preserved.
PROXY_PORT_INSTRUCTIONS_PC: Apply now starts capture and updates the Windows proxy. Later saves a pending change without changing Windows settings. Captured history is preserved.
PROXY_PORT_INSTRUCTIONS_MANUAL: XMAT cannot change this device's proxy settings automatically. Apply now starts the new listener after you confirm the old port is no longer used. You must update the device/app to use the new endpoint. Later only saves a pending change.
PROXY_PORT_MANUAL: Update the device/app proxy settings manually to the assigned port. XMAT has not verified the device configuration.
PROXY_PORT_MANUAL_CONFIRM: Before continuing, stop the device/app from using port {0}. Have you done so? XMAT will start port {1}; you must then update the device/app proxy settings manually.
PROXY_OPERATION_BUSY: Another capture operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish and retry.
PROXY_NO_LOCAL_ADDRESS: No local IPv4 address is available for this proxy. Check the PC's network connection.
PROXY_DEVICE_BUSY: Another proxy configuration operation owns device {0}. Wait for it to finish or cancel it from its capture tab.
PROXY_CONFIGURATION_UNKNOWN: The effective device proxy endpoint could not be verified: {0}. No new proxy configuration was applied.
PROXY_CONFIGURATION_TIMEOUT: The expected proxy configuration was not confirmed after waiting for the console. Last state: {0}. Check the console and proxy status before retrying.
PROXY_ENDPOINT_CONFLICT: The device uses proxy {0}, not this tab's requested endpoint {1}. Disable or reconfigure the existing proxy explicitly first; it will not be overwritten automatically.
PROXY_DISABLE_FOREIGN_CONFIRM: The console currently uses proxy {0}, which does not match this tab. Continuing explicitly removes that proxy configuration and restarts the console. Continue only if you intend to disable that other proxy.
PROXY_SETTINGS_SAVE_FAILED: The proxy settings could not be saved. No successful save was recorded: {0}

LTA_REPEATED_CALLS_DESC: Reports when identical calls are made within a small window of time.
LTA_REPEATED_CALLS_VIOLATION: Repeated call found {0} other times in calls to endpoint.
LTA_BATCH_CALLS_DESC: Detects when a series of batch API calls are made close together that can potentially be combined to reduce the overall number of calls to the endpoint.
LTA_BATCH_CALLS_DATA_ALLOWED: Allowed Time Between Calls in ms
LTA_BATCH_CALLS_VIOLATION: A set of {0} Batch Calls was found within a time window of ({1}ms) to endpoint. Total XUID count ({2}). Consider combining into one call.
LTA_BURST_CALLS_DESC: Analyzes the calls frequency and detects periods of increased calls for investigation.
LTA_BURST_CALLS_VIOLATION: Burst increase of {0} calls to endpoint found.
LTA_FREQ_CALLS_DESC: Analyzes the frequency of calls over the length of the capture and reports the number of times that the title exceeded the expected limits.
LTA_FREQ_CALLS_VIOLATION_EXCEEDED: Exceeding rate limits for '{0}' required for title certification( limit of {1} calls with {2} calls in {3} seconds).  Failure to adhere to the specified limits may block a title from release, and in-production issues with released titles may result in service suspension up to and including title removal.
LTA_FREQ_CALLS_VIOLATION_SUSTAINED: Call frequency above the sustained call limit for '{0}' (limit of {1} exceeded with {2} calls in {3} seconds).
LTA_FREQ_CALLS_VIOLATION_BURST: Call frequency above the burst call limit for '{0}' (limit of {1} exceeded with {2} calls in {3} seconds).
LTA_FREQ_CALLS_VIOLATION_SHORT: Average time of {0}ms between calls is too short
LTA_FREQ_CALLS_VIOLATION_LONG: Calls are taking longer than expected to return {0}ms
LTA_FREQ_CALLS_VIOLATION_MAX: The maximum call time for calls is greater than allowed {0}ms
LTA_POLL_CALLS_DESC: Finds sequences of calls that appear to be polling of a service.
LTA_POLL_CALLS_VIOLATION: Polling detected in a sequence of {0} calls at a rate of approximately {1} min:sec
LTA_SMALL_CALLS_DESC: Detects uses of batch APIs with a small number of users.
LTA_SMALL_CALLS_VIOLATION: Batch call detected for endpoint for a small sized set of {0} XUIDs.
LTA_THROTTLE_CALLS_DESC: Reports the number of throttled calls per endpoint. Multiple throttled call indicates the title is not properly handling a 429 response. See results.log for call limits.
LTA_THROTTLE_CALLS_VIOLATION_MULTI: Sequence of throttled calls detected on endpoint.
